A customer emailed us at 2:14am to say our export button "felt slow."

Not that it was slow. That it felt slow. It ran in 1.8 seconds.

We spent a week on it anyway. Added a progress bar. Kept the 1.8 seconds.

Support tickets about exports: zero since.

I keep thinking about what that means for every performance dashboard I have ever built. We measure the seconds. They measure the waiting.

The progress bar took an afternoon. The dashboard took a quarter.
